title: Care Index Metadata
description: Protocol metadata for Universal Care Protocol discovery profiles and responses. Care Index diverges from UCP in key areas—see DIVERGENCES.md.

version.description: Care Index protocol version in YYYY-MM-DD format. DIVERGENCE: Care Index requires EXACT version match, not permissive ≤. Mismatch MUST error, not proceed.

version_negotiation.description: DIVERGENCE FROM UCP: Strict version matching. Care is continuous, not transactional. Version drift causes silent coordination failures that harm people.

match_status.description: MUST be exact_match to proceed. version_mismatch MUST error.

cache_requirements.description: DIVERGENCE FROM UCP: Mandatory cache limits. Caregiver availability changes hourly. Day-old stale profiles are harmful.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum cache age in seconds. MUST NOT exceed 14400 (4 hours) for availability-sensitive data.

must_revalidate.description: Platforms MUST revalidate before using cached profiles for matching.

availability_max_age_seconds.description: Real-time availability data MUST NOT be cached longer than 1 hour.

governance.description: DIVERGENCE FROM UCP: Transparent power asymmetries. UCP obscures; Care Index owns.

governance_transparency_url.description: URL documenting governance structure and decision-making.

services.description: Service definitions keyed by reverse-domain service name.

discovery_profile.title: Care Index Discovery Profile
discovery_profile.description: Full Care Index metadata for /.well-known/care-index discovery.

resource_profile.title: Resource Profile
resource_profile.description: Care resource provider metadata for discovery.

resource_types.description: Types of care this resource provides.

service_area.description: Geographic area where resource provides care.

accepts_programs.description: Benefit programs accepted (e.g., Medicaid waiver codes).

response_match.title: Care Index Match Response
response_match.description: Care Index metadata for match responses.

response_session.title: Care Index Session Response
response_session.description: Care Index metadata for care session responses.
